screening_decisions.reason: Randomised clinical trial of adults hospitalised with HF. Intervention group received a tablet computer containing HF information and lifestyle advice (mHealth-delivered education via tablet) versus control receiving standard HF information only. Meets all inclusion criteria.

Three-group parallel-randomized trial in stable HF patients comparing the heartfailurematters.org website on top of usual care versus usual care. The website provides web-based HF education. Meets inclusion criteria as RCT of web-based mHealth education versus usual care.

Randomized controlled pilot study of a web-based self-care intervention for HF patients. Intervention is internet/web-based education and self-management support versus usual care. Meets inclusion criteria.

RCT comparing SMS, telephone and regular follow-up methods. The interventions are follow-up modalities, not mHealth-delivered education programmes. The study does not compare education delivered via mHealth versus usual care.

RCT evaluating an integrated dyad care program delivered primarily through nurse-led face-to-face counseling, with computer-based education and written materials as components. The intervention is not primarily mHealth-delivered education versus usual care; it is a multicomponent psychoeducation intervention.

Cost-effectiveness analysis of the same nurse-led dyad intervention as study 5 (face-to-face counseling, computer-based education, written materials). Not primarily mHealth-delivered education versus usual care.

RCT of a nurse-guided education program with facilitated telephone communication and scheduled follow-up visits. The intervention is not mHealth-delivered education; it relies on in-person and telephone delivery.

RCT comparing standard education plus video education versus standard education alone. Video education is not an internet/web-based, SMS, app, or social media mHealth intervention per the selection criteria.
Pilot usability study with 8 HF patients over 6 months using an mHealth system. No randomization; observational/feasibility design only.
This paper reports on recruitment challenges and reasons for refusal in an mHealth medication management study. It is not an RCT reporting outcomes of mHealth-delivered education versus usual care.
Pilot RCT of a web-based home care monitoring system assessing medication compliance and physiologic parameters. The intervention is remote monitoring, not mHealth-delivered education.
Proof of concept field study using purposeful sampling and constant comparative analysis. Not an RCT.
Descriptive survey design assessing usability of the HeartMapp mobile application with 37 participants. No randomization; not an RCT.
Study protocol for a randomized clinical trial. No trial results reported; the study has not been completed at the time of publication.

Multisite RCT of a collaborative care disease management intervention including home telemonitoring and guided self-management support. The telemonitoring component is for data transmission and clinician monitoring, not specifically mHealth-delivered education versus usual care.
Study protocol describing the design of the CASA trial. No results reported.

Six-month randomized field experiment comparing a technology-enhanced practice model (HeartCareII website) to usual care delivered by home care nurses. Patients were trained to use web-based resources relevant to their care needs. This constitutes web-based mHealth education versus usual care.

RCT of motivational interviewing with telephone follow-up versus traditional health education. The intervention is delivered via in-person sessions and telephone calls, not through mHealth modalities (internet/web/apps/SMS/social media).

Intervention trial in Indigenous people with cardiovascular disease or at high CVD risk, not specifically HF. Uses an interactive tablet application during in-person education sessions, but the population does not meet the HF diagnosis criterion.

RCT of a mobile phone-assisted case management program. The intervention focuses on monitoring and case management to improve self-efficacy and quality of life, not specifically mHealth-delivered education versus usual care.
Randomized field study of telehomecare effects on hospitalization and symptoms. The telehomecare intervention is remote monitoring of clinical indices, not mHealth-delivered education.
RCT investigating telehealth influence on self-management of HF. Intervention is a video-based telehealth system for monitoring, not mHealth-delivered education.
RCT of continued telehealth use (Health Buddy system) after discharge from formal home health services. The intervention is remote monitoring and symptom tracking, not mHealth-delivered education.

RCT investigating internet-based synchronized face-to-face video group discussions and Fitbit feedback for exercise adherence. The intervention targets exercise behavior and social support, not mHealth-delivered HF education versus usual care.
Quasi-experimental design with convenience sample. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Development and feasibility evaluation paper describing creation of a web-based program. Twelve patient volunteers tested the program. No randomization; not an RCT.

RCT of e-mail reminders sent to home health nurses about HF clinical recommendations. The intervention targets nurses, not patients; it is not mHealth-delivered education to HF patients versus usual care.
Feasibility study with 10 community-dwelling HF patients using an HF app for two weeks. No control group; not an RCT.
Study protocol for a telerehabilitation RCT. No results reported.
Systematic literature review of home-based ICT interventions for chronic disease management. Not a primary RCT.
Pilot RCT of telemonitoring medication adherence with telephonic support versus passive monitoring. The intervention is adherence monitoring, not mHealth-delivered education.

RCT of a multifaceted telehealth intervention for homebound older adults with HF or COPD. The intervention is telehealth care delivery, not specifically mHealth-delivered HF education versus usual care.
Feasibility RCT comparing electronic pill box versus smartphone app medication reminders. The intervention is medication reminders, not mHealth-delivered education.
Pilot RCT of the MedSentry remote medication monitoring system versus usual care. The intervention monitors medication taking, not delivering HF education via mHealth.

Project evaluating integrated care services across multiple conditions (COPD, cardiac failure, diabetes) using various technologies. Not an RCT specifically comparing mHealth-delivered HF education versus usual care.
The provided abstract describes a smoking reduction trial recruitment feasibility study, not an HF mHealth education RCT. Inconsistent with title and not relevant to the review criteria.

RCT of an internet-based telemedicine system for frequent surveillance and communication between HF patients and providers. The intervention is remote monitoring and management, not mHealth-delivered education.
RCT of a web-based telemedicine system for store-and-retrieval communication and surveillance. The intervention is monitoring to reduce care encounters, not mHealth-delivered education.
Study protocol for the TELEMED-HF RCT. No trial results reported.
Overview and meta-level synthesis of systematic reviews on home telemonitoring for HF. Not a primary RCT.
Economic model derived from meta-analysis of RCTs on remote patient monitoring. Not a primary RCT.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of device telemonitoring RCTs. Not a primary RCT.
Multicenter RCT of ICT-guided disease management with or without telemonitoring. The intervention is disease management and monitoring, not specifically mHealth-delivered education versus usual care.
Review of automated computer-based telephone messaging across multiple conditions. Not HF-specific and not a primary RCT.
Prospective analysis of 15 patients in a clinical trial evaluating clinical decision support. Not an RCT comparing mHealth education versus usual care.
Retrospective analysis of telephonic health coaching outcomes. Not an RCT. The intervention is telephone coaching, not mHealth-delivered education.
RCT in sedentary young adults at risk of heart disease, not patients with diagnosed HF. Primary prevention population does not meet the HF diagnosis criterion.

Mixed-methods pilot study randomized to mHealth equipment, digital home equipment, or standard care. The mHealth intervention is remote monitoring connected to a call center, not mHealth-delivered education.
Qualitative study using interviews with 14 elderly HF patients using digital pens. No randomization; not an RCT.

RCT of an online heart disease support group in heart patients from coronary heart disease registries. Not specifically HF population, and the intervention is peer support, not structured mHealth-delivered education versus usual care.

RCT of systematic nurse and pharmacist-led education using an interactive Kodak Photo-CD Portfolio technique versus conventional information. Photo-CD is not an internet/web-based, app, SMS, or social media mHealth intervention.

RCT comparing standard information plus interactive CD-ROM education versus standard information alone. CD-ROM education is not delivered via internet/web, smartphone/tablet app, SMS, or social media.
Quasi-experimental design allocating patients to control or experimental groups without randomization. Not an RCT.
Proof of concept test with 12 patients using a web-based tablet-accessed application. No randomization; not an RCT.
Proof of concept study with 7 HF patients receiving internet-based CBT. No control group; not an RCT.

Pilot RCT of internet-based cognitive behavioral therapy for depressive symptoms in HF patients versus a web-based discussion forum. The intervention is psychotherapy for depression, not mHealth-delivered HF education versus usual care.

RCT of remote monitoring and fluid monitoring in patients with implantable cardiac devices. The intervention is device monitoring, not mHealth-delivered education. Population is defined by device implantation, not specifically HF diagnosis.
RCT of telemonitoring during home health care for older HF patients. The intervention is remote physiological monitoring, not mHealth-delivered education.
RCT of multidisciplinary disease management program versus usual care. The intervention is team-based disease management, not mHealth-delivered education.
Study protocol describing the MITI-HF trial design. No results reported.
RCT of nurse-led motivational interviewing delivered via home visit and telephone calls versus usual care. The intervention is delivered in-person and by telephone, not via mHealth modalities.
Cost-effectiveness analysis of ICDs, CRT-Ps, and CRT-D using decision analytical model. Not an RCT of mHealth education.
Retrospective review comparing remote monitoring versus hospital-only follow-up for ICD recipients. Not an RCT.
RCT of e-mail reminders to home health nurses about HF care practices. The intervention targets nurses, not patients, and is not mHealth-delivered patient education.
RCT of tailored telephone monitoring versus usual care. The intervention is telephone-based monitoring, not mHealth-delivered education via internet/web, apps, SMS, or social media.
Descriptive qualitative study of practice nurses' perceptions of telehealth services. Not an RCT.

Large RCT of remote patient monitoring with health coaching telephone calls and telemonitoring versus usual care. The intervention combines telephone coaching and physiological monitoring, not specifically mHealth-delivered education.
Meta-analysis and narrative review of consumer health IT for HF. Not a primary RCT.
Review of implantable and non-implantable monitoring devices for HF. Not a primary RCT.

Cluster-randomized trial of telephone-based health coaching for chronic diseases including HF. The intervention is telephone coaching, not mHealth-delivered education via internet/web, apps, SMS, or social media.
RCT of telemonitoring system with telephone support versus usual care. The intervention is remote physiological monitoring, not mHealth-delivered education.
Randomized and matched-cohort study of remote patient monitoring with live and video-based nursing visits. The intervention is monitoring and nursing visits, not mHealth-delivered education.
Qualitative formative study using focus groups to adapt a telemonitoring intervention. Not an RCT.

RCT of mobile health support using interactive voice response (IVR) telephone calls with automated self-care support and email summaries to caregivers. IVR telephone calls are not internet/web-based, app-based, SMS, or social media-delivered education per the selection criteria.
Protocol for the E-Coach RCT using interactive voice response (IVR) technology. No results reported.

Pragmatic RCT of an IVR-augmented care transition intervention versus usual care for CHF/COPD patients. The technology is interactive voice response (telephone-based), not the mHealth education modalities specified in the selection criteria.

RCT of patient access to a web-based online medical record with an educational guide and messaging system. While it contains an educational guide, the primary intervention is medical record access and communication, not mHealth-delivered education versus usual care.
Cluster-randomized trial of a web-based family history assessment tool for multiple conditions. Not an HF-specific population or intervention.

The provided abstract discusses glycaemic control in diabetes and CHF, not a multidisciplinary telehealth program. Regardless, the content does not describe an RCT of mHealth-delivered HF education versus usual care.
Qualitative formative evaluation using focus groups to assess the iSCIP intervention. Not an RCT.
Qualitative interview study with patients and clinicians who used mobile phone-based telemonitoring. Not an RCT.

RCT of mobile phone-based telemonitoring (daily weight, BP, ECG, symptom questions) versus control. The intervention is primarily physiological monitoring with automated instructions, not mHealth-delivered education versus usual care.
Protocol for a smartphone-based telemonitoring RCT. No results reported.
Study protocol for the COPE-HF RCT using telephone-based coping skills training. No results reported.

RCT of single-session interactive computer-based education in HF clinics versus standard education. Computer-based education delivered in clinical settings is not mHealth (mobile health) delivered via internet/web for smartphones/tablets, SMS, or social media.
Review of remote monitoring for cardiac implantable electronic devices. Not a primary RCT of mHealth education.
Protocol for the MOTIVATE-HF RCT. No results reported.
Pilot trial of home telemonitoring for HF and COPD. The abstract describes a small pilot with mixed results. Not a clear RCT of mHealth education versus usual care.
RCT of a DVD and booklet decision aid versus basic written materials. DVD/video is not an internet/web-based, app-based, SMS, or social media mHealth intervention.

RCT of integrated telemonitoring and telecare using a handheld PDA versus usual outpatient follow-up. The intervention is remote monitoring and patient-clinician contact, not mHealth-delivered education.
Survey assessing quality and availability of consumer HF information materials across Australia. Not an RCT.
Prospective study comparing 40 older HF patients in a web-based program with 40 age- and sex-matched controls receiving usual care. Not randomized; control group was matched retrospectively.
Retrospective study examining hospital utilization 90 days after telemonitoring. Not an RCT.
Cost analysis using case-matched retrospective chart reviews. Not an RCT of mHealth education.
Feasibility study with 30 healthy volunteers testing a telemonitoring system. No HF patients and no randomization.
The provided abstract is about Bosnian war survivors' psychological distress, not HF or telephone interventions. Regardless, the title indicates it is a protocol with no results.
Methodology paper developing a taxonomy of behavior change techniques. Not an RCT.
Registry analysis of nonadherent HF patients using GWTG-HF data. Not an RCT.

RCT of collaborative disease management with telephone-based monitoring and education. The intervention is telephone-based and nurse-coordinated, not mHealth-delivered education via internet/web, apps, SMS, or social media.
Methodology paper presenting the GRADE system. Not an RCT.
RCT of telephone education and counseling versus brief education. The intervention is delivered by telephone, not via mHealth modalities (internet/web, apps, SMS, social media).
Review article on HF epidemiology and risk factors. Not an RCT.
Review article on cognitive impairment in HF. Not an RCT.
Review article on HFpEF epidemiology. Not an RCT.
Secondary analysis examining mediation of social support and adherence by self-care confidence. Not an RCT.
RCT of a web-based diabetes education program. Population is type 2 diabetes, not HF.
Prospective cohort study examining quality of life as a predictor of mortality. Not an RCT.
Review article summarizing factors related to self-care in HF. Not an RCT.
RCT of an entertainment-based decision aid for breast cancer surgery. Population is breast cancer, not HF.
Individual patient data meta-analysis of self-management interventions for HF. Not a primary RCT.
Meta-analysis examining relationship between remodeling and mortality. Not a primary RCT of mHealth education.
Review of patient satisfaction with telemedicine in HF. Not a primary RCT.
Subgroup analysis of a drug trial (ATMOSPHERE) comparing aliskiren and enalapril. Not an mHealth education intervention.
Scientific statement presenting a disease management taxonomy. Not an RCT.
Systematic review of web-based interventions for chronic diseases. Not a primary RCT.
Meta-analysis of catheter ablation for ventricular tachycardia. Not related to mHealth education for HF.
Systematic review of computer-based patient self-management programs. Not a primary RCT.
Cohort study examining numeracy and health literacy as predictors of 30-day recidivism. Not an RCT.
Methodology paper introducing the Behaviour Change Wheel framework. Not an RCT.
Meta-analysis of remote patient monitoring for HF. Not a primary RCT.
Before-after study of a text messaging program for HF self-management. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Survey of primary care providers about physical activity counseling. Not an RCT in HF patients.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of computer-based diabetes self-management interventions. Population is diabetes, not HF.
Systematic review and network meta-analysis of remote monitoring after HF hospitalization. Not a primary RCT.
Commentary article on eHealth and community nursing. Not an RCT.
RCT of an avatar-based depression self-management intervention in young adults with depressive symptoms. Population is not HF.
Nationwide cohort study of HF hospitalization and mortality trends. Not an RCT.
Observational study evaluating online education and coaching program within the HeartCycle study. Not an RCT.
RCT of tablet-based education versus conventional education in lung transplant patients. Population is lung transplantation, not HF.
Cross-sectional study examining cognitive deficits and self-care in elderly HF patients. Not an RCT.
Protocol for the PIONEER-HF drug trial. Not an mHealth education intervention.
Systematic review of cognitive impairment in HF. Not a primary RCT.
RCT comparing a printout of an ultrasound image with explanation versus generic information. The intervention is a printed image, not mHealth-delivered education.
Developmental project describing creation and beta testing of a mobile app for HF education with 10 patients. Not an RCT.
Study of 60 inpatients receiving IVRS voice messages via Mp3 player after discharge. No control group described; not an RCT.
Article describing development and pilot evaluation of the Heart Messages intervention. Not an RCT reporting primary outcomes versus usual care.
RCT of tailored telemonitoring versus usual care. The intervention is remote monitoring, not mHealth-delivered education.
RCT of an in-home education-support intervention delivered by advanced practice registered nurses. The intervention is in-person nurse delivery, not mHealth-delivered education.
Usability study of a mobile-monitoring system in minority HF patients. Not an RCT.

RCT of ICT-guided disease management combined with telemonitoring versus ICT-guided disease management alone. The intervention is monitoring and disease management, not specifically mHealth-delivered education versus usual care.
RCT of person-centred telephone support versus usual care. The intervention is telephone-based, not mHealth-delivered education via internet/web, apps, SMS, or social media.
RCT of telephone-based health coaching versus usual care. The intervention is delivered by telephone, not via mHealth modalities.
Review article on treatment adherence and ICT in HF. Not a primary RCT.
Prospective longitudinal study of telemonitoring use by elderly HF patients. Not an RCT.
RCT comparing web-based education plus email versus web-based education plus telephone sessions. No usual care control group; does not meet the comparator requirement of 'versus usual HF care'.
Dissertation comparing web-site access versus web-site plus telephone education sessions. No usual care control group; does not meet the comparator requirement.

RCT of mobile phone-based health coaching with telemonitoring for diabetes and heart disease patients. The population includes diabetes and HF, and the intervention is health coaching plus monitoring, not specifically mHealth-delivered HF education versus usual care.
Observational study describing transition from trial to routine operation of a telemonitoring system. Not an RCT.
RCT of telecare with electronic data upload to a nurse-led monitoring station for diabetes, CHF, or COPD. The intervention is remote monitoring, not mHealth-delivered education.
Description of a telehealth network protocol for HF management in Sri Lanka. Not reporting RCT results.
Editorial/commentary on home monitoring in HF disease management. Not an RCT.
Quasi-experimental multicenter study comparing nurse-directed education versus routine care. Not a randomized controlled trial.

RCT comparing predischarge education, telephone support, both, or usual care. The interventions are in-person education and telephone support, not mHealth-delivered education via internet/web, apps, SMS, or social media.
Pilot study abstract examining feasibility of mHealth monitoring in rural older adults with HF. Not an RCT.
Explorative pre-post design study implementing the OPTILOGG e-health tool. No control group; not an RCT.
Experimental study of self-care education for hospitalized HF patients. The intervention is in-person education, not mHealth-delivered education.
News article about a smartphone app for cardiac patients. Not an RCT.

Appears to be an RCT initially, but the control group consisted of 95 patients who "refused to use the smartphone app" while the intervention group were 47 patients who accepted it. This is self-selection, not randomization. The study is therefore not a randomized controlled trial.
RCT of a self-management group programme in primary care versus standard care. The intervention is delivered in group sessions by primary healthcare staff, not via mHealth modalities.
Retrospective analysis of rehospitalization rates among home health patients receiving telehealth. Not an RCT.
Quality improvement project examining teach-back telephone calls. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Descriptive study examining readiness for eHealth among HF patients. Not an RCT.

RCT of telehealth self-management versus standard outpatient management. The intervention is telehealth self-management (broader than mHealth education), not specifically mHealth-delivered education versus usual care.

RCT comparing standard mHealth (IVR calls with self-management advice) versus mHealth plus caregiver feedback. The mHealth component uses interactive voice response (telephone) calls, not internet/web-based, app-based, SMS, or social media education per the selection criteria.
Quasi-experimental study of motivational interviewing. Not a randomized controlled trial.

RCT of mobile phone-based remote patient monitoring (daily weight, BP, ECG, symptom questions) versus standard care. The intervention is remote monitoring with automated instructions, not primarily mHealth-delivered education versus usual care.
Feasibility study of the Health Empowerment Intervention. Not an RCT.
Observational study of user retention in a mobile health app (Cardiogram). Not an RCT of HF education.

Quality improvement project using daily automated telephone calls to assess risk. While randomized, the intervention is telephone-based risk stratification, not mHealth-delivered education via internet/web, apps, SMS, or social media.
Protocol for a non-randomised open-label study. Not an RCT and no results reported.
Commentary/report on the BEAT-HF RCT of telemonitoring and nurse coaching. The intervention is telemonitoring, not mHealth-delivered education.
Design and usability evaluation of a web-based symptom monitoring tool. Not an RCT.
Review article on technology-based training for ICD patients. Not a primary RCT of mHealth HF education.
Clinical practice guideline. Not an RCT.
Review of global HF hospitalization registries. Not an RCT.
RCT of an avatar-hosted behavior change intervention for young adult smokers. Population is smokers, not HF patients.
Review article on educational strategies to reduce HF readmissions. Not a primary RCT.
Systematic review of mHealth-based HF interventions. Not a primary RCT.
Position statement on e-health. Not an RCT.
Review article on self-care in HF. Not an RCT.
Cross-sectional study examining health literacy and HF knowledge. Not an RCT.
Prevalence survey of technology use patterns. Not an RCT.
Cochrane review of interactive telemedicine. Not a primary RCT.
Position paper on digital health implementation. Not an RCT.
Qualitative study using interviews to identify barriers to self-care. Not an RCT.
Abridged Cochrane systematic review and meta-analysis. Not a primary RCT.
Cochrane review of structured telephone support and telemonitoring. Not a primary RCT.
Systematic review and network meta-analysis of telemedicine for HF. Not a primary RCT.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of home telemonitoring for HF. Not a primary RCT.
Commentary on social determinants of health. Not an RCT and not related to HF mHealth education.
Reporting guideline for systematic reviews. Not an RCT.
Statistical update report. Not an RCT.
Cross-sectional study of nursing home performance and hospital readmissions. Not an RCT.
Clinical practice guideline. Not an RCT.
Review of telehealth impact on HF self-management. Not a primary RCT.
Policy statement on telehealth implementation. Not an RCT.
Cochrane review of disease management interventions for HF. Not a primary RCT.
Commentary on shared decision making. Not an RCT.
Review of telemedicine solutions for medication adherence in cardiovascular disease. Not a primary RCT of HF mHealth education.
Systematic review and network meta-analysis of transitional care services for HF. Not a primary RCT.
